div.head: Ger 5.1
div.ab: [5.1] A swa he gecneordra swa bið he weorðra, gyf he wið witan hafoð his wisan gemæne.
A swa he gecneordra swa bið he we|orðra gyf he wið witan hafoð his wisan gemæne
A swa he gecneordra swa bið he weorðra, gyf he wið witan hafoð his wisan gemæne.
Immer je eifriger, um so würdiger ist er, wenn er mit Verständigen seine Lebensweise gemeinsam hält.
The more diligent he always is, the more worthy he is, if he shares his way of life with men of understanding.
Always the more diligent he is the worthier he will be, if he has his learning in common with a wise man.
If he is ever the more diligent, so shall he be the more deserving, if he takes his guidance from a wise man.
div.note: ‘swa … swa’ is a rhyming pair; ‘witan’ means men of understanding (he shares the conduct of those worthy of respect; compare 1).

note.seg: shares the way of life of respectable men [cf. 1]
Verf. sucht seinen Berufstand moralisch zu heben.—‘Je fleissiger um so geschätzter, wenn er den Weg eines klugen Mannes verfolgt’ Sk-Wi
The author seeks to raise the moral standing of his profession.—‘The more diligent, the more esteemed, if he follows the way of a wise man’ Sk-Wi
